citations.long: Equipment used in the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of drug products is not of appropriate design, of adequate size, and suitably located to facilitate operations for its intended use.

citations.short: Items to cover on annual reviews
citations.long: Written procedures are not established for evaluations done at least annually and including provisions for a review of complaints, recalls, returned or salvaged drug products, and investigations conducted for each drug product.
Procedures describing the handling of written and oral complaints related to drug products are deficiently written or followed.
Equipment and utensils are not cleaned at appropriate intervals to prevent contamination that would alter the safety, identity, strength, quality or purity of the drug product.

citations.short: Establish reliability of supplier's C of A
citations.long: Establishment of the reliability of the component supplier's report of analyses is deficient in that the test results are not appropriately validated at appropriate intervals.
Inspection of the packaging and labeling facilities immediately before use is not done to assure that all drug products have been removed from previous operations.

citations.short: Master production and control records, procedure
citations.long: The preparation of your master production and control records was not described in a written procedure.
There is a failure to thoroughly review any unexplained discrepancy whether or not the batch has been already distributed.
Complaint records are deficient in that they do not include the findings of the investigation and follow-up.

citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.
Equipment for adequate control over temperature is not provided when appropriate for the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of a drug product.

citations.short: Establish reliability of supplier's C of A
citations.long: Establishment of the reliability of the component supplier's report of analyses is deficient in that the test results are not appropriately validated at appropriate intervals.

citations.short: Changes to Procedures Not Reviewed, Approved
citations.long: Changes to written procedures are not reviewed and approved by the quality control unit.

Acceptance criteria for the sampling and testing conducted by the quality control unit is not adequate to assure that batches of drug products meet each appropriate specification as a condition for their approval and release.

citations.short: Review of representative number of batches
citations.long: Written procedures are not followed for evaluations conducted at least annually to review records associated with a representative number of batches, whether approved or rejected.

citations.short: Reporting of adverse drug experience to FDA
citations.long: Written procedures describing the handling of all written and oral complaints do not include provisions for review to determine whether the complaint represents a serious and unexpected adverse drug experience which is required to be reported to the Food and Drug Administration.

citations.short: Product flow through building is inadequate
citations.long: The flow of components, drug product containers, closures, labeling, in-process materials, and drug products though the building is not designed to prevent contamination.

citations.short: Buildings not maintained in good state of repair
citations.long: Buildings used in the manufacturing, processing, packing, and holding of a drug product are not maintained in a good state of repair.
Equipment and utensils are not cleaned at appropriate intervals to prevent contamination that would alter the safety, identity, strength, quality or purity of the drug product.

There are no written procedures for production and process controls designed to assure that the drug products have the identity, strength, quality, and purity they purport or are represented to possess.
Drug products do not bear an expiration date determined by appropriate stability data to assure they meet applicable standards of identity, strength, quality and purity at the time of use.
There is a failure to thoroughly review any unexplained discrepancy whether or not the batch has been already distributed.
